Q5786.reason: Post-injury refusal is a failure to mitigate under the avoidable-consequences rule, so the estate recovers for the wound and pain up to the refusal, not a total bar and not the avoidable death.

Q5253.reason: Reversions remain with the grantor and are exempt from the Rule Against Perpetuities, whereas contingent remainders, executory interests, and vested remainders subject to open are all subject to it.

Q5347.reason: Stored muscle ATP is the direct fuel and lasts only about 1–2 seconds of maximal contraction; phosphocreatine and glycolysis replenish ATP only after that.
